findings.quote:
`bash tools/mutate-and-run.sh
   --selftest` → `MUTATE_SELFTEST: 67/67 pass` / `VERDICT: PASS`, rc 0 at tool
   sha256 `cf41efaa…`
findings.skill_statement: The section gives 67/67 as the tally of `bash tools/mutate-and-run.sh --selftest`, but that command at C* prints `MUTATE_SELFTEST: 107/107 pass` (measured on the C* bytes, sha256 977de470…); 67/67 belongs to an earlier tool blob (content sha cf41efaa…, round 7), and the arrow carries no date, so a cold reader who runs the command the section names gets a different tally than the one the section states.
